tasks.short: Assess and treat hearing disability under audiologist direction

steps.what: Read the actual patient record and locate the audiologist's current assessment instructions
Take the actual patient history and perform the directed hearing assessment
Transfer the identified test results into the working assessment form
Interpret the actual assessment within scope and write the specific proposed care action for audiologist review
Review the completed assessment and proposed action and give the actual audiologist direction
Carry out the exact directed hearing-care action with the patient
Check the patient's actual response and identify unresolved concerns
Write the actual care delivered, response and unresolved concerns in the working patient note
Save the ordinary working note in the same patient-record system

tasks.design: Configure patient-linked instructions and exact test-result transfer in {OTHER}, the hearing assessment and patient-record system. Keep patient assessment, interpretation, actual audiologist direction, care delivery and post-care note writing with the responsible people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test values could be recopied into a separate assessment form and current instructions searched manually.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient identifiers and test-field mappings can populate a draft without diagnosing or choosing treatment.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing problems and patient response require professional assessment within the actual scope of practice.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist listens to the patient and works under the audiologist's real direction.

ambition.what: No expanded diagnostic or treatment authority.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: patient-linked instructions and exact test-field transfer can support assessment documentation without automating diagnosis or treatment.

assumptions: Boundary is the stated directed assessment-and-care episode, including the actual working patient record. The audiologist's real direction is required by this task, not a newly invented supervisory review for paperwork.

The specialist collects patient history and produces test results in s2. Fields are patient identifier, test identifier, date, ear side, measurement and units; identity, units and completeness are checked in s4. Missing fields remain manual.

The exact proposed action and assessment exist before audiologist review in s5. Any clinical-context or action change voids a1 and returns to the actual audiologist, rather than allowing machine treatment choices.
Test native instrument-to-record configuration first. Existing result import and native test runtime earn zero new saving. No new model diagnosis is proposed.

Post-care note writing occurs after the actual response. Save1 is minimum integer representation of near-zero same-system time, fully retained without author approval. Any actual referral or external report send needs its own final-version authority and action.
Shares are unmeasured episode estimates. Audiologist work stays fully retained outside the specialist's denominator; no transferred labour saving is claimed.
unknowns: Actual specialist scope and audiologist direction route
Whether test values are already imported
research_questions: Which exact result fields are still manually transferred after current native configuration?

already_counted.description: Specialist context checks, patient assessment, interpretation, directed care, response check and actual note writing remain counted.
Actual audiologist review and direction remain fully counted outside the focal denominator.

incremental.description: Maintain result-field mapping and instruction-version links.

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient-specific care action completed in s4 and directed by the audiologist in s5; any action or clinical-context change voids this direction.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Focal B90 R78 gives gross13.3333333 less upkeep2, net11.3333333. Low: test-ear and unit codes are incompatible, retaining7 of10 result-transfer units, and instruction lookup retains9 of10;4/90*100 less2 gives2.4444444, rounded down to2.4. All clinical work, actual audiologist direction and note authorship remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Patient assessment, directed care and professional relationships stay central; less time goes to locating instructions and copying test fields.
reach: Work with the audiologist on instruction versioning; learn test identifier and unit conventions.
role.ambitious_version: A specialist who keeps accurate, traceable records while preserving the audiologist's actual clinical direction.
